blocks.html: At the end of the shift, or as weather conditions otherwise warrant, the operator of the hoisting equipment must properly park or secure the hoisting equipment for occurring or forecasted winds in accordance with the specifications of the manufacturer of the hoisting equipment and applicable plans.
